headline: Attack on RAB in Brahmanbaria: Chief of Shafiq's gang arrested in Dhaka
summary: The leader of a group responsible for attacking Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) personnel in Brahmanbaria has been captured by security forces in the capital.
details: The chief of the 'Shafiq Bahini' (Shafiq's gang) has been arrested in Dhaka following an attack on the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) in Brahmanbaria.
The arrest was carried out by security forces in the capital city after tracking the suspect's movements.
The suspect is being held for his alleged role in leading the group that targeted RAB personnel during an operation in Brahmanbaria.
Authorities are continuing their investigation into the group's activities and other potential accomplices involved in the attack.
caption:
The leader of the gang that attacked RAB personnel in Brahmanbaria has been caught in Dhaka.

The chief of the 'Shafiq Bahini' (Shafiq's gang) has been arrested in Dhaka following an attack on the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) in Brahmanbaria.

The arrest was carried out by security forces in the capital city after tracking the suspect's movements.

The suspect is being held for his alleged role in leading the group that targeted RAB personnel during an operation in Brahmanbaria.

Authorities are continuing their investigation into the group's activities and other potential accomplices involved in the attack.

headline_marked: Chief Whip says [[no chance to rewrite constitution]], Jamaat Amir warns of no polls
headline: Chief Whip says no chance to rewrite constitution, Jamaat Amir warns of no polls
summary: The Chief Whip has stated there is no opportunity to rewrite the constitution, while Jamaat-e-Islami's Amir warns that elections may not happen in 2026 without a referendum provision.
details: The Chief Whip has clearly stated that there is no opportunity or provision to rewrite the constitution of Bangladesh.
caption:
No rewriting of the constitution? Jamaat-e-Islami warns of a political deadlock as the Chief Whip shuts the door on constitutional changes.

The Chief Whip has clearly stated that there is no opportunity or provision to rewrite the constitution of Bangladesh.
